If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

translations.web: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
translations.bsb: Can anyone indict me? If so, I will be silent and die.
translations.kjv: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
translations.asv: Who is he that will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the ghost.
